name: dragino-ldds75
description: Ultrasonic distance sensor (tank level, parking): distance, battery, optional DS18B20 temperature
caveats:
1) Battery mask: the official decoder computes (bytes[0]<<8|bytes[1]) & 0x3FFF; the table spec uses plain u16. The field is KEPT because the mask never matters in real LDDS75 frames: the manual documents BAT as plain mV with no status bits (examples 0x0B45=2885mV, 0x0B49=2889mV) and the 3.6 V Li-SOCl2 supply bounds the value at ~3600 = 0x0E10, far below bit 14 (0x4000) — the mask is boilerplate carried over from other Dragino models.
2) Distance sentinels (not filterable by the grammar): 0x0000 means "ultrasonic sensor not detected" (decodes as 0 mm); since firmware v1.1.4 any reading below the 280 mm minimum is transmitted as 0x0014 and decodes as 20 mm meaning "invalid". Valid flat-object range is 280-7500 mm.
3) DS18B20 temp (bytes 5-6) is an optional external probe; the manual does not document the value sent when no probe is attached (other Dragino nodes emit 0x7FFF, which this spec would decode as 3276.7 °C) — treat implausible temp values as "no probe". Byte 7 sensor_flag refers to the ultrasonic probe (1=detected), not the DS18B20.
4) Firmware before v1.1.3 uplinks only 4 bytes (BAT+Distance); the grammar's out-of-frame fields are simply skipped, so short frames still decode bat and distance correctly.
5) Codec covers only the periodic/interrupt uplink on FPort 2; Dragino device-status (FPort 5) and datalog frames are intentionally not handled.
6) interrupt and sensor_flag are unitless 0/1 numbers (no HA device class).
